## Tree-equivalence check (the check that matters, not the self-reported SHA)

git diff --name-only 89e2f98e29c289ae8ad9e00dd310104fea9fd7df HEAD -- .   (excluding .github/skills/dxc-issue-triage/)
  -> files outside the skill dir: 0
  

CONTROL -- same query against the ground-truth commit's own parent, which must
show a real difference (proves the diff command can detect one):

git diff --name-only 89e2f98e29c289ae8ad9e00dd310104fea9fd7df^ HEAD -- .   (excluding .github/skills/dxc-issue-triage/)
  -> files outside the skill dir:
  tools/clang/unittests/HLSLExec/LinAlgTests.cpp
  (this is exactly the one file 89e2f98e2 itself touched --
   tools/clang/unittests/HLSLExec/LinAlgTests.cpp -- confirming the query is
   sensitive and the zero-diff result above is not a broken query)

Conclusion: main-debug's source tree is identical to public upstream
89e2f98e29c289ae8ad9e00dd310104fea9fd7df outside this skill directory. The binary self-reports a
fork-local merge commit (7665270b9 above), which resolves for nobody else;
89e2f98e29c289ae8ad9e00dd310104fea9fd7df is the upstream commit the source corresponds to and is
what is cited throughout this issue's artifacts.
